title: Docs: Console Suggestions (beta) — interpreting savings & risk, limitations, troubleshooting
author: Simran Kaur
description: Summary: Adds the first customer-facing docs for the Redwood Console “Suggestions” view (beta) to help users understand what they’re seeing and how to safely act on it (read-only in beta). This PR covers: (1) how to interpret savings estimates (including confidence ranges and what the baseline is), (2) how to interpret risk levels (low/medium/high) and what factors contribute, (3) known limitations for beta, and (4) troubleshooting/FAQ (why you may not see suggestions, why savings changed week-over-week, and what “insufficient telemetry” means). Context: This content is based on the internal Confluence draft and support FAQ review threads; it’s intended to unblock beta onboarding for the initial allowlisted cohort. Notes: We intentionally avoid wording that implies guaranteed savings or automated changes; the Console is read-only in beta and suggestions are advisory. Checklist: - [x] Add overview page for Suggestions (beta) - [x] Add “Interpreting savings estimates” section with disclaimers + examples - [x] Add “Interpreting risk levels” section mapped to taxonomy language - [x] Add Troubleshooting/FAQ (feature flag/RBAC/telemetry freshness) - [x] Add cross-links from Optimize docs + Console nav index - [x] Support reviewed copy for common tickets (SUP-19344/SUP-19402) Links: Confluence draft: /confluence/eng-developer-experience/docs-site/console-optimize-suggestions-beta-docs (internal) Risk taxonomy reference: ADR-0274 Savings estimate contract reference: ADR-0275

conversation: Dev Patel (Support readiness lead): “Can we add explicit language for why savings can change week-to-week? This is the bulk of SUP-19344. Also needs a clearer ‘What to do next’ when risk is High.” Simran Kaur (author): “Added a ‘Why did my savings change?’ subsection: baseline window (last 7d), traffic mix, and telemetry freshness; also added guidance to validate with a canary + monitor p95 latency/quality. For High risk: added bullets that map to what we show in the drawer (‘limited latency headroom’, ‘high workload variance’, ‘low confidence in cache hit-rate estimate’) and a note that High risk doesn’t mean unsafe, it means we can’t confidently predict impact without validation.” Tessa Morgan (Design): “Please match Console terminology: use ‘Suggestion details’ + ‘Basis of estimate’ (capitalization) and keep the risk disclaimer short at the top; longer explanation can be below.” Simran Kaur: “Updated headings + the first paragraph to align with UI labels, and moved the long-form explanation into an expandable ‘Learn more’ section.” Naomi Feldman (Security/compliance product reviewer): “Make sure we don’t imply users can export or share tenant usage-derived data. Also, mention RBAC and audit logging without listing internal event names.” Simran Kaur: “Adjusted the RBAC section to ‘Access is restricted by workspace role and org policy’ and added a single sentence: ‘Access to Suggestions may be logged for audit purposes.’ Removed internal event names.” Aditya Rao (Optimize product lead): “Please add one concrete example of savings units: $/1M tokens and monthly estimate; and clarify that batching + caching aren’t additive in all cases.” Simran Kaur: “Added an example callout with $/1M tokens + monthly projection (with range), and a note that the UI attempts to avoid double-counting; some suggestions may be mutually exclusive depending on route/model settings.” Marissa Cole (Console product lead): “Looks good for beta. Ensure we state read-only clearly and that enablement is allowlist/feature-flagged.” Simran Kaur: “Added a banner at the top of the overview page: ‘Beta (read-only): Suggestions provide guidance and do not change configuration.’ Added ‘How do I get access?’ in FAQ referencing allowlist/feature flags.” Approvals: Dev Patel approved after copy edits; Tessa Morgan approved after terminology changes; Naomi Feldman approved after security wording changes; Aditya Rao and Marissa Cole approved.
release_notes: Console docs: Added Suggestions (beta) documentation covering savings/risk interpretation, beta limitations, and troubleshooting/FAQ for missing suggestions and telemetry prerequisites.
